name: Jar of wintergreen ointment
description: A jar of ointment smelling of wintergreen. Rubbed into a wound, it dulls the pain and keeps it a little cleaner.
notes: An ointment, so the item is the whole 50 ml jar, as with the existing antiseptic; the look step allows this as a per-unit figure. Pain relief and mild antisepsis should follow the existing antiseptic's fields when the refactor applies drafts.

name: First aid case
description: An empty red plastic case with a white cross and a carry handle. Holds bandages and medicine.
notes: The empty case; its contents are separate items. The container follows the existing ammo can's fields; the pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Plastic barrel
description: A blue 30 gallon plastic barrel with screw bungs in the top. Holds water or fuel without leaking.
notes: Closed-head with two bungs, the common blue drum, so it reads apart from the two steel drums. Liquid storage of about 115 L has no content field yet; the size is a placeholder for a thing too big to pocket. The aluminium tank variant rides on this model.

name: Steel drum (100 L)
description: A red 30 gallon steel drum with a lid held by a bolted clamp ring. Holds liquids and stands over a fire.
notes: Open-head with a clamp ring, so it reads apart from the closed 200 L drum. cooking stands for a boiling quality; liquid storage has no content field yet, and the size is a placeholder. The 200 L aluminium tank is a variant here, though it would fit steel_drum_200's size better; the fire barrel rides here too.

name: Steel drum (200 L)
description: An olive 55 gallon steel drum with two screw bungs in the top. Holds fuel or water and stands over a fire.
notes: Closed-head with two bungs. cooking stands for a boiling quality; liquid storage has no content field yet, and the size is a placeholder. The variants ride on this model, though the 30 gallon barrel would fit plastic_barrel better and the oil extractor would want its own still parts.
